title: Piceatannol ameliorates intestinal barrier dysfunction in urosepsis by modulating the Nrf2/ROS/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Gong, Xue; Chen, Shenquan; Liu, Dan; Lin, Yulong; Chen, Yaoguang; Fu, Jiaxiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白皮杉醇通过Nrf2/ROS/NF-kappaB通路改善尿源性脓毒症肠屏障功能障碍，仅用分子对接评估小分子与Nrf2蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Urosepsis is a life-threatening condition. Intestinal barrier dysfunction in sepsis drives disease progression and significantly determines mortality. Piceatannol exhibits potent anti-oxidative and anti-inflammatory activities and protects intestinal barrier homeostasis; however, its role and mechanisms in urosepsis-induced intestinal barrier dysfunction remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic potential of PIC in intestinal injury during urosepsis. Molecular docking was performed to evaluate the interaction between PIC and nuclear factor E2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) proteins, revealing a binding energy of -6.7 kcal/mol for the Nrf2-PIC complex. A murine urosepsis model was established by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) injection into the renal pelvis, while an in vitro model used LPS-stimulated human colon epithelial NCM460 cells. PIC treatment significantly attenuated LPS-induced intestinal barrier dysfunction and suppressed oxidative stress and inflammatory responses in both models. Mechanistically, PIC modulated the activation of the Nrf2/reactive oxygen species (ROS)/NF-kappaB pathway, which is closely associated with oxidative stress and inflammation. Notably, pretreatment with the Nrf2 inhibitor ML385 partially blocked the protective effects of PIC on the intestinal barrier, along with its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that PIC ameliorates intestinal barrier dysfunction by attenuating LPS-triggered oxidative stress and inflammatory responses via modulation of the Nrf2/ROS/NF-kappaB pathway in both NCM460 cells and uroseptic mice.
abstract_zh: 尿源性脓毒症是一种危及生命的疾病。脓毒症中的肠道屏障功能障碍驱动疾病进展，并显著决定死亡率。白皮杉醇 (Piceatannol) 具有强效抗氧化和抗炎活性，并保护肠道屏障稳态；然而，其在尿源性脓毒症诱导的肠道屏障功能障碍中的作用和机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨PIC在尿源性脓毒症期间肠道损伤中的治疗潜力。通过分子对接 (molecular docking) 评估PIC与核因子E2相关因子2 (Nrf2) 蛋白之间的相互作用，结果显示Nrf2-PIC复合物的结合能为-6.7 kcal/mol。通过向肾盂注射脂多糖 (lipopolysaccharide, LPS) 建立小鼠尿源性脓毒症模型，而体外模型使用LPS刺激的人结肠上皮NCM460细胞。PIC治疗显著减轻了LPS诱导的肠道屏障功能障碍，并在两种模型中抑制了氧化应激和炎症反应。机制上，PIC调节了Nrf2/活性氧 (reactive oxygen species, ROS)/NF-kappaB通路的激活，该通路与氧化应激和炎症密切相关。值得注意的是，用Nrf2抑制剂ML385预处理部分阻断了PIC对肠道屏障的保护作用，以及其抗氧化和抗炎效应。综上所述，这些发现表明，PIC通过调节Nrf2/ROS/NF-kappaB通路，在NCM460细胞和尿源性脓毒症小鼠中减轻LPS触发的氧化应激和炎症反应，从而改善肠道屏障功能障碍。
